findings.message: Run schedule '0 0 6 ? * 1' uses a number for the day of week ('1'). NiFi 1.x (Quartz) counts 1 as Sunday; NiFi 2.x (Spring) counts 1 as Monday, so the schedule shifts by one day without any error.
findings.suggestion: Use day names (SUN, MON, ...) instead of numbers.
findings.title: Cron expression with a numeric day of week

findings.message: Run schedule '0 0 12 * * ? 2030' has seven fields. NiFi 2.x uses Spring cron expressions, which have no year field, so the component is invalid.
findings.suggestion: Remove the seventh field. Components can no longer be scheduled for a specific year.
findings.title: Cron expression with a year field

findings.message: UpdateAttribute used the EVENT_DRIVEN scheduling strategy, which NiFi 2.x removed; it now runs TIMER_DRIVEN with a run schedule of 0 sec.
findings.suggestion: Check the run schedule and the number of concurrent tasks after the upgrade.
findings.title: Event-driven scheduling replaced by timer-driven
